clauses.title: CL-D110 records review-only accounting across fresh runs
clauses.section: ## CL-D110 — Review-only carries earlier rounds and stops after five without MERGE_READY
requires: At five counted rounds a run stops `WAITING_FOR_OWNER` before any validation or gate and names the count.
Changing N, reading a round from an untrusted author or a bot, or carrying a needs-owner-decision line requires a new owner decision.

clauses.title: The review-only driver reads earlier rounds and stops at five
review-only.md names the cross-run bound
requires: - Across fresh runs of one pull request (CL-D110): its earlier rounds are the trusted conversation comments that open `# Review state:` with a `tidd-status` block for the target; their findings reach every gate as settled, except a needs-owner-decision line, and after five such rounds without `MERGE_READY` a run stops `WAITING_FOR_OWNER` before any gate, until a `MERGE_READY` round or a trusted `tidd-budget: continue` comment restarts the count.

clauses.title: CL-D11 and CL-D93 name the cross-run bound
The ledger and the stop are pinned
requires: Issue #259 the findings of earlier rounds reach every gate as settled, with the head they were raised on
Issue #259 a round by an untrusted author or a bot, or for another target, is not read
Issue #259 five earlier rounds without MERGE_READY stop the run before any gate
Issue #259 a MERGE_READY round or a trusted continue comment starts the count again
